name: TYPO3
description: TYPO3 is an open-source enterprise content management system for structured websites and digital experiences. It supports page trees, content elements, media, users, workspaces, localization, extensions, and configurable frontend rendering.
agentUseSummary: TYPO3 cannot currently be connected to Relay agents through a uniform supported core content API: remote JSON and REST surfaces are supplied by optional extensions or installation-specific code whose routes, schemas, authentication, permissions, and output are configurable.

blocked.label: Connect a TYPO3 core content API
blocked.description: TYPO3 core does not publish one uniform remote content API contract that Relay can safely bind across customer-operated installations.

blocked.label: Assume an optional API extension
blocked.description: Headless, t3api, nnrestapi, and custom extensions have installation-specific routes, schemas, fields, authentication, permissions, and maintenance; Relay will not silently choose or install one.

blocked.label: Use private or scraped access
blocked.description: Relay will not scrape frontend or backend HTML, automate a browser, query TYPO3's database, reuse backend sessions, or reverse engineer custom endpoints.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No agent actions can be enabled until Relay separately approves a named TYPO3 API extension and pinned contract for the target installation.

runtimeSupport.description: No uniform supported TYPO3 core remote content API or MCP service is available to mount as OpenClaw tools.
No uniform supported TYPO3 core remote content API or MCP service is available to mount as Hermes tools.

providerSetup.blocker: TYPO3 core does not define one uniform remote content API. Documented JSON and REST surfaces are optional extensions or custom implementation frameworks whose installation, routes, resource models, schemas, output fields, authentication, permissions, and lifecycle vary per site.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not show Connect or request TYPO3 credentials. Reconsider only when a customer explicitly commissions a named, pinned API extension and version for a controlled installation, with its exact routes, authentication, resource projection, permissions, maintenance owner, and Fairfax acceptance separately reviewed.

evidence.supports: TYPO3's official core API overview documents PHP and extension-development APIs within the CMS rather than a uniform external content resource contract.
The TYPO3 Headless documentation identifies its JSON content API as functionality provided by an optional extension whose output can be customized.
The t3api documentation requires separately installing the extension, importing route configuration, and annotating installation-specific Extbase models as API resources.

The nnrestapi documentation describes another separately implemented extension framework whose endpoints, access, authentication, responses, uploads, and configuration are defined by the installation.
